title: Max builds a power station (it fought back)

beats.text: Max wanted free electricity for his town. His reactor had other plans.
Let's see how he got here.
Uranium fuel rods in a tank of water. Every splitting atom gives off heat, and the water glows blue.
Each split fires neutrons that split more atoms: a chain reaction.
Great, until nothing stops it. More splits, more heat, and the tank boils over.
The fix: control rods. They soak up spare neutrons, so pushing them in slows everything down.
Calm, hot water. Max holds up a light bulb. Nothing. Heat isn't electricity.
So the steam spins a turbine, which spins magnets inside copper coils. That's electricity.
But the used steam has nowhere to go. Pressure climbs and the turbine chokes to a stop.
A condenser turns it back into water, and the cooling tower dumps the heat. That cloud is just vapour.
One problem left. Max walks up with a Geiger counter, and it starts screaming.
So it goes inside a steel-lined dome of concrete about a metre thick. Silence.
Night falls, Max pulls the lever, and the whole town lights up. Safely. Which disaster would you have fixed first?

cta: Which disaster would you have fixed first?
